_comment: Copy to ingest-state.json during setup, keeping only the sources you chose. A null watermark means 'never run'; the first ingest should use a short window, not all of history.

chat.access: how you reach it, e.g. a local CLI with its own store
chat.notes: which groups are in scope, which are excluded

email.notes: what counts as noise: newsletters, receipts, login links

reading.notes: bookmarks and watched videos; reference library, not commitments

documents.access: a folder you drop files into
